claim: The one-click demo starts with sample sessions and never reads or changes the real log.
where: landing hero, demo banner, README, privacy
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a real record, mutate and reset demo storage, then prove the real record is unchanged

claim: A set records weight, unit, reps, effort, six set-context markers, and a note.
sandbox: demo data; save all fields and inspect the downloaded JSON record

claim: Choosing a saved exercise shows its previous session before the next entry.
where: hero art caption, how it works, README
sandbox: fresh demo; assert the earlier session numbers, markers, and note appear above the entry fields

claim: Sets stay in browser storage and can be erased with the in-app control.
sandbox: fresh demo; save and reload a record, observe request origins, erase it, and inspect the demo database

claim: JSON export downloads every set in a Set Context Log backup.
sandbox: fresh demo; download JSON and validate schema and one record per seeded set

claim: CSV export downloads every set with units, markers, and correctly escaped notes.
sandbox: fresh demo; add punctuation-heavy context, download CSV, and assert header, escaping, unit, markers, and row count

claim: JSON import adds new set IDs without replacing existing records.
sandbox: fresh real log; import a duplicate and a new ID, then inspect exported records

claim: Changing the default unit does not convert saved sets.
sandbox: fresh real log; save kg, change default to lb, and verify the exported saved unit

claim: History groups saved sets by session.
sandbox: fresh demo; assert four session groups contain all six seeded sets

claim: Finishing a session starts a separate session, even on the same day.
sandbox: fresh real log; finish one same-day session and assert its set becomes previous-session context

claim: The app reloads and keeps demo records offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh demo; activate the service worker, go offline, reload, save, and reload again

claim: Anonymous use has no account, analytics, cloud sync, remote fonts, third-party runtime scripts, or workout generation.
sandbox: fresh demo with full request interception and loaded-resource inspection

claim: The complete product is free to use without a purchase or license.
sandbox: fresh real log; assert entry, history, import, export, settings, and erase controls are available with no purchase UI

claim: The build type-checks and emits dist/index.html, the demo route, and a versioned service worker.
sandbox: Playwright web server runs npm run build first; inspect the emitted files and service-worker version

claim: Static deployment config sets cache, manifest MIME, security headers, and a designed 404 response.
sandbox: inspect staticwebapp.config.json and request an unknown route from the production-like preview

claim: Home, Demo, Privacy, Terms, and 404 have real titles, metadata, navigation, and legal links.
sandbox: crawl every local document route and assert status, title, canonical, one h1, main, header, footer, and links

claim: The hero and share images derive from the original generated product artwork.
sandbox: verify source and optimized hashes, prompt sidecar, provenance text, and 1200 by 630 PNG dimensions
